description: SnowSure helps skiers and snowboarders find real-time powder, compare 14-day multi-model snow forecasts, and plan trips across 500+ ski resorts worldwide. Ask natural-language questions via the Answer Engine, browse ranked snow reports, inspect individual resort conditions, compare weather models, explore destination hubs like Niseko or Chamonix, and review season history and intelligence insights — all grounded in SnowSure's verified snow data.

defaultPrompt: How are the snow conditions in Valle Nevado?
Where is the deepest ski resort base currently?
Can you show me the global snow report?
